reading: President Trump from the US talked about Canada.
He said Canada wants to enjoy the benefits of being a US state.
Trade talks between the US and Canada did not succeed.
The discussions *collapsed*, meaning they failed completely.
Canada's Prime Minister announced new taxes on goods from the US.
These are *retaliatory tariffs*, taxes made as a punishment.
He said Canada was *reluctantly* introducing these new tariffs.
The Prime Minister *accused* the US of starting a problem.
He stated that the US started a *trade war* between the countries.
This means both nations are putting higher taxes on each other's products.

vocabulary.definition: Stopped working or failed suddenly; fell down.
Special taxes placed on imported goods from another country as a form of punishment or response.
To do something unwillingly or without really wanting to.
Said that someone did something wrong or was guilty of something.
When countries put high taxes or restrictions on each other's goods, causing economic conflict.
Advantages or good effects that something has.

entries.ja: 急に機能しなくなったり、失敗したり、崩れ落ちたりした。
entries.zh-Hans: 突然停止运作或失败；倒塌。
entries.es: Dejó de funcionar o falló de repente; se cayó.
entries.pt-BR: Parou de funcionar ou falhou subitamente; caiu.

entries.ja: 罰として、または報復として、他国からの輸入品に課される特別な税金。
entries.ko: 처벌 또는 대응의 형태로 다른 나라에서 수입된 상품에 부과되는 특별 세금.
entries.zh-Hans: 作为一种惩罚或回应，对来自另一个国家的进口商品征收的特殊税款。
entries.es: Impuestos especiales aplicados a bienes importados de otro país como forma de castigo o respuesta.
entries.pt-BR: Impostos especiais aplicados a produtos importados de outro país como forma de punição ou resposta.

entries.ja: 気乗りしないまま、または本当はしたくないと思いながら何かをすること。
entries.ko: 마지못해 또는 정말로 원하지 않으면서 무엇인가를 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 不情愿地或并非真心想做某事。
entries.es: Hacer algo de mala gana o sin realmente quererlo.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer algo sem vontade ou sem realmente querer.

entries.ja: 誰かが何か悪いことをした、または何かの罪があると述べた。
entries.ko: 누군가가 잘못을 저질렀거나 어떤 일에 유죄라고 말했습니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 指责某人做错了事或有罪。
entries.es: Dijo que alguien hizo algo mal o fue culpable de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Disse que alguém fez algo errado ou era culpado de algo.

entries.ja: 国々がお互いの商品に高い税金や制限を課し、経済的な対立を引き起こすこと。
entries.ko: 국가들이 서로의 상품에 높은 세금이나 제한을 부과하여 경제적 갈등을 일으키는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 当国家之间对彼此的商品征收高额关税或施加限制，从而引发经济冲突。
entries.es: Cuando los países imponen altos impuestos o restricciones a los productos de otros, causando un conflicto económico.
entries.pt-BR: Quando países aplicam impostos altos ou restrições aos produtos uns dos outros, causando conflito econômico.

entries.ja: 何かが持つ利点や良い効果。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 가지는 이점이나 좋은 효과.
entries.zh-Hans: 事物所具有的优势或良好效果。
entries.es: Ventajas o buenos efectos que algo tiene.
entries.pt-BR: Vantagens ou bons efeitos que algo possui.
